title: HoloMap: Important Systems
summary: Read the HoloMap signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Terrain tiles, waypoints, marker states, overlays, and route records all contribute to the same navigation layer.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch marker names, overlay meaning, waypoint distance, terrain readability, route windows, and whether old marks are now lying to you.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A HoloMap system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
